programs.title: H.G. Wells' The Food Of The Gods
programs.desc: Get ready for a taste of hell! Legendary creature-feature director Bert I. Gordon delivers the biggest installment of his career with this spine-tingling tale of ecology grown big and gone berserk. Based on H.G. Wells' classic horror novel.

programs.title: The Outer Limits
programs.desc: In the tradition of the 1960s cult show of the same name, this anthology series features different actors, many well-known from their previous work, in each episode. The episodes often explore eerie and often supernatural themes with a science-fiction element.

programs.title: The Outer Limits
programs.desc: "There is nothing wrong with your television set." That famous line opens each episode of the classic science fiction anthology series as part of a narration that makes people think their TVs are being controlled. Episodes of the series, which numbered 49 over the course of two seasons, range from a mix of sci-fi and horror that feature "scary monster" motifs to episodes focused on the sci-fi aspects of the stories. Episode writers include such notables as series creator Leslie Stevens and Harlan Ellison.

programs.title: Stargate Universe
programs.desc: Led by the brilliant scientist Dr. Nicholas Rush, a band of civilians and soldiers faces a whole new world -- and fights for survival -- after their secret military base is attacked. The survivors emerge aboard an ancient ship, unable to return to Earth and now on a course to parts unknown. Amid the darkness the group must meet its most basic needs of food, water and air while discovering the secrets of the ship's Stargate to ultimately survive.
